summary: Bradford's Instagram record on transit centers on improving TTC reliability, safety, and accountability while addressing congestion. Bradford supports a 15-minute TTC money-back guarantee, platform edge doors, police presence and cleanliness/lighting standards in stations, and a Congestion Relief Commissioner. Bradford advocates for grade-separated rapid transit, citing Finch West, and pushes for the Eglinton East and Scarborough LRTs alongside the Waterfront East LRT. Bradford opposes the rideshare cap, the simultaneous Gardiner/Line 2 closures, and the RapidTO permanent reconfiguration tied to the World Cup. On cycling, Bradford supports "safe and sensible" bike lanes built with community consultation (citing Danforth), criticizing Bloor West's process. Bradford previously championed ActiveTO, Destination Danforth, electric buses, Bike Share expansion, and the King Street Pilot as TTC Chair and councillor.

key_positions.stance: Supports a 15-minute TTC money-back service guarantee that refunds fares when trips are delayed
Supports installing platform edge doors at TTC subway stations
Supports increased police/security presence, cleanliness, and lighting standards at TTC stations
Supports the Eglinton East and Scarborough LRT projects, criticizing what is described as inequitable funding compared to the Downtown Waterfront LRT
Supports a Congestion Relief Commissioner / Traffic Czar with accountability for reducing gridlock
Supports rapid transit grade-separated from car traffic, citing Finch West LRT as cautionary example
Opposes caps on rideshare (Uber/Lyft) vehicle licenses
Supports 'safe and sensible' bike lanes built with community consultation on a case-by-case basis
Opposes RapidTO permanent reconfiguration of Bathurst/Dufferin tied to World Cup; supports time-limited pilot
Supports reopening King Street to vehicles while streetcars are not running due to construction
Supports electrifying the TTC bus fleet by 2040 and investments in zero-emissions transit
Supports Bike Share Toronto expansion and active transportation infrastructure
Opposes simultaneous Gardiner Expressway and Line 2 weekend closures as poor planning
States TTC reliability has declined and ridership/safety needs to be restored
Supports building cell service across the TTC network
